content: {"themes":[{"cluster":0,"name":"Cleaning Fee Dispute","description":"Customers claim they were wrongly charged cleaning fees and demand refunds."},{"cluster":1,"name":"Incorrect Driver Rating","description":"Users accidentally gave low ratings and want to correct or understand rating scores."},{"cluster":2,"name":"Free Donut Promo Confusion","description":"Customers are unsure why they didn’t receive promised free donuts after order cancellations."},{"cluster":3,"name":"Lost Item Contact Failure","description":"Riders left personal items in the vehicle and cannot reach the driver through the app."},{"cluster":4,"name":"Promo Code Eligibility Issues","description":"Users cannot use promo codes because the system says they are not eligible."},{"cluster":5,"name":"Promo Code Not Applying","description":"Customers report promo codes failing to apply or being marked as already used."},{"cluster":6,"name":"Food Order Errors and Cancellations","description":"Customers receive wrong meals, experience long waits, or have orders cancelled unexpectedly."},{"cluster":7,"name":"Account Hacked or Compromised","description":"Users suspect unauthorized access to their accounts and need security assistance."},{"cluster":8,"name":"Excessive Wait Times/ETA Inaccuracy","description":"Riders experience longer than promised arrival times and delayed pickups."},{"cluster":9,"name":"Unpleasant Car Odor","description":"Passengers complain about strong or unpleasant smells inside the driver’s vehicle."},{"cluster":10,"name":"Payment Method Adding Failures","description":"Customers cannot add or update credit cards or other payment methods in the app."},{"cluster":11,"name":"Phone Number Verification Problems","description":"Users struggle to verify or change phone numbers linked to their accounts."}]}
